text_block_list.text:
On New Year's Day, on the way to 
Hatsumode――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Going to visit the shrine this year as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see. Actually, I also had something I 
wanted to pray for, so I was just heading 
over there myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: May I join you?
And so, we headed to the shrine together.
(Clap, clap...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "...Alright. Sorry to keep you waiting."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Carried upon the first spring breeze, 
surely. May it reach them.
choice_data_list: So what did you pray for?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Praying that your days ahead are 
warm and bright, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You have always been right beside me in 
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
At times like a gentle breeze, at times 
like a fierce gale. Always, as a tailwind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"When that came to mind, I felt I simply 
had to pray. For your days ahead."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Please have a wonderful year, Trainer.

—And after that, on her suggestion, we 
decided to go visit some shrines.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Looking around, there are so many stalls 
lined up. Carrot pancakes, takoyaki...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, they are handing out oshiruko over 
there...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There are so many amulets at the amulet 
office.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A shrine bustling under the late winter 
breeze is truly a lively sight.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, which one should we go to first?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Understood. There are many stalls here, so 
let us take our time, as leisurely as a 
gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely scent. The fragrant breeze 
carries an appetizing aroma...
(...*whimper*...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, pardon me. ...My stomach seems to 
have growled.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
May I have some grilled carrots? They're 
sweet and very delicious, you know.

And so, our second New Year came to an 
end. I want to keep running alongside her 
throughout this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how lovely. A sweet scent drifts 
along with the gentle breeze."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Shall we go and claim it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it's so hot that I can barely eat 
it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I need you to keep blowing with the 
blossoms for just a little while longer."

And so, our second New Year came to an 
end. I want to keep running alongside her 
throughout this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to be honest, I was curious about it 
too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
They're so colorful, like little birds 
chirping in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Doesn't that charm look a little 
like a Daruma doll?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This white and grey charm looks just like 
Shiomame-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...How lovely. Is its blessing for 'good 
health and longevity'?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Could I get two of these, 
please?
choice_data_list: Are you giving that to someone?
Is that a gift for someone?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...To Trainer. Fufu."

And so, our second New Year came to an 
end. I want to keep running alongside her 
throughout this year as well.
